# Vendored browser dependencies

- `qrcode-generator-1.4.4.js` is locally bundled for the existing CEO-dashboard QR feature. Its MIT license is in `LICENSE-qrcode-generator.txt`.
- `xlsx.full.min.js` is SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3, downloaded from the official SheetJS distribution. It is used locally to read legacy `.xls`, `.xlsx`, and CSV files and to create `.xlsx` exports. It is licensed under Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE-sheetjs.txt`.

No workbook data is bundled with these libraries.
